proposal.reason: Primary change is open-source CI execution logic: dual-platform case generation/grouping/reconciliation (M890P + OAM-810E), workflow matrix/resource policy updates, optional HPN SDK installation in build/test jobs, CI runner/report metadata wiring, and corresponding xtest fixtures/tests (including the large new postsil_unit_test_shm list). Edits in workflow docs/scripts are in support of this CI behavior, not contribution/reviewer policy or PCCL runtime module semantics.
